acceptedAnswer.text: Laloo is a website offering walking routes. These routes highlight locations of restroom and drinking water facilities near the path you’ll take. You can find Laloo at https://www.laloo.org.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find Laloo routes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Currently, Laloo provides walking routes specifically for Budapest.

mainEntity.name: How many walking routes are available in Budapest?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are two walking routes presently available for Budapest users on Laloo.

mainEntity.name: What are the names of the Budapest walking routes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The routes are called 'Parliament and Basilica' and 'Buda Castle and the River'.

mainEntity.name: What landmarks are included in the 'Parliament and Basilica' route?

acceptedAnswer.text: This route visits the Hungarian Parliament, Kossuth Lajos tér, St. Stephen's Basilica, and Széchenyi Chain Bridge.

mainEntity.name: How long is the 'Buda Castle and the River' route?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 'Buda Castle and the River' route is 2.042 kilometers long and takes approximately 24 minutes and 48 seconds to complete by walking.

mainEntity.name: Are restroom and water facilities available along the Laloo routes in Budapest?

acceptedAnswer.text: Currently, no restroom or drinking water points have been recorded along either of the Budapest routes.
